description:
What is This Part?
This part is the Suzuki OEM Lug Nut Stud that fits into the Front Rotor and receives the lug nut after the wheel has been mounted.
It is part number 09119-12008.
To replace all studs it requires 5 studs per rotor.
These are for the front wheels only.
The rear wheels requires stud #09119-12006, which we also sell. To purchase that item select the œWheels/Spare Tire Category in the far left column.
NOTE: THESE WHEEL STUDS ARE THE NON-CLIPPED HEAD. The 1986 – 1988 have a clipped head. This changed occurred in the late 88′ thru early 89′ models so please verify which type you need if you are ordering for an 88′ or 89′ Samurai. From the 90′ model Samurai on to 95™ they were all Non-Clipped.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 10 – Lug Nut Studs (Front Wheel)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1988 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1988 – 1995 All Models
